Name: Seraiah
Summary: Seraiah was the scribe in David's administration, recording the kingdom's affairs beside Joab, Jehoshaphat, Zadok, and Abiathar.
KeyStory: Seraiah kept the records of David's kingdom at its height.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 8:17; Ezra 2:2; Nehemiah 7:7; Nehemiah 10:2; Nehemiah 12:1; Nehemiah 12:12
RelatedPeople: King David; Joab; Zadok, Son of Ahitub; Zerubbabel
LifeLesson: Kingdoms run on scribes whose names survive in a single verse.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
